blocks.text: U.S. President Donald Trump's top political adviser, chief of staff Susie Wiles, is leaving the White House just days after the Republican Party's midterm defeat
To be replaced by Stephen Miller, Trump says in Truth Social post
U.S. President Donald Trump's top political adviser, chief of staff Susie Wiles, is leaving the White House just days after the Republican Party's midterm defeat.
Trump announced Wiles's departure in a post on Truth Social and said she'll be replaced by deputy chief of staff Stephen Miller, the key architect of the president's immigration policies.
